name: Whistle
description: A pea-less referee-style whistle that prints lying on its side with no supports: a 1.2 mm windway (never under 1 mm), an open window with a bevelled labium edge, and a round chamber. Three shapes, a scale factor, a lanyard loop, and an optional name inlaid flush in the side. The whistle prints on extruder 1, the name on extruder 2.
source: inspired by Printables "Flat Pocket Whistle" (Jonas Daehnert, 99,539 downloads) and "Ultra Compact Mini Whistle 100 dB on your Keychain" (Franken 3D, 68,836 downloads)
